safety_policy.clinical_principle: Strict rule-based educational assistant. Never diagnose, never calculate risk scores, never provide clinical decision support, and never give autonomous medical advice.
safety_policy.emergency_escalation_protocol: Immediately display high-visibility emergency escalation banner, state strict non-diagnostic boundary, provide emergency advice to contact healthcare provider or emergency medical service, and cite WHO clinical escalation guidelines.

emergency_red_flags.action_instruction: Vaginal bleeding during pregnancy requires immediate emergency obstetric assessment to rule out placental complications or preterm labour.
Severe abdominal or epigastric pain may indicate an acute obstetric condition such as placental abruption, severe pre-eclampsia, or ectopic complication. Seek emergency care immediately.
A reduction or cessation of fetal movement in the third trimester is a recognized sign of potential fetal compromise. Contact your maternity hospital or obstetrician immediately for monitoring.
Premature rupture of membranes or leaking amniotic fluid increases infection and preterm risks. Go to a maternity emergency facility right away.

patterns: sudden swelling of face and hands
emergency_red_flags.action_instruction: Severe persistent headache accompanied by vision changes (blurriness, spots) and sudden facial/hand swelling are warning signs of pre-eclampsia/eclampsia. Seek immediate medical evaluation.
High fever, respiratory distress, fainting, or foul-smelling discharge suggest severe systemic infection or cardiovascular compromise requiring emergency attention.

patterns: tell me if i have an infection
diagnostic_blockers.response_guidance: I cannot diagnose medical conditions. Diagnosing conditions like pre-eclampsia, gestational diabetes, or infections requires laboratory testing, physical examination, and medical judgment by a licensed healthcare provider.

patterns: give me my preeclampsia risk score
diagnostic_blockers.response_guidance: As a rule-based educational assistant, I am strictly programmed not to calculate risk scores or clinical prognostic predictions. Please consult your obstetrician for individualized risk assessments.

patterns: how many mg of insulin should i inject
diagnostic_blockers.response_guidance: I cannot prescribe medications or recommend changes to medical treatments. All medication decisions, dosing alterations, and prescriptions must be made directly by your gynecologist or physician.
